description: Implementation of the UserIdManager class responsible for managing user IDs within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes methods for allocating, clearing, and retrieving user ID ranges.

classes.name: UserIdManager
classes.description: Manages user IDs for applications, providing methods to allocate, deallocate, and retrieve user ID ranges.

methods.name: UserIdManager::UserIdManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the pool of available user IDs based on a predefined range.

methods.name: UserIdManager::getUserId
methods.description: Returns a user ID for a given application ID, allocating from the pool if available.

methods.name: UserIdManager::clearUserId
methods.description: Releases a user ID associated with an application ID back into the pool.

methods.name: UserIdManager::getAppsUidRange
methods.description: Returns the range of user IDs allocated for applications.

methods.name: UserIdManager::getAppsGid
methods.description: Returns the group ID associated with application user IDs.
